description: Allowed CNAME target suffixes. A subdomain's CNAME value must end with one of these; anything else is rejected and needs manual review. Only hosts where a free-tier site can be reached through an external CNAME are listed.
note: Hosts like Canva, Webflow, Notion, Wix, Squarespace, WordPress.com and Medium are intentionally excluded: their custom-domain features are paid or do not work with a plain external CNAME, so pointing here would produce a broken site.
